purpose: Compact pill for short tags, applied filters, and selected entities, with optional removal or toggle interactions via its mode prop.
useWhen: Representing issue labels, free-form tags, applied filters, or selected entities.
Offering a small toggleable option inside a group of choices.

avoidWhen.reason: Showing a numeric count, short status, or compact category annotation next to another element — use badge instead.
Picking one of a small fixed set — use segmented-control instead.
Showing label and value metadata for a record, such as an owner, a date or a price — use description-list instead.
